purpose: Stable Home Screen app pointer. The Home Screen icon should point to pmp-app-current.html; this map decides which app file is current.

current_app.label: PMP v14 direct Home Screen app
current_app.reason: Direct Home Screen wrapper that skips the v7-v10 wrapper stack and keeps vault/Resident lossless support.

update_rule: Future app updates should update this map or pmp-app-current.html, not require a new Home Screen install.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. Do not install individual version files again unless recovering from a broken current pointer.
